hero_kpi_rationale: The Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) is the key KPI because it captures visibility into future revenues from non-cancelable contracts, essential for a growing SaaS company with a recurring revenue model, and directly reflects commercial traction despite persistent losses.

kpis.name: Remaining Performance Obligations
kpis.explanation: Amount of future contractual revenues not yet recognized, including non-cancelable contracts and deferred revenues.
kpis.description: RPO decreased slightly but remains high, reflecting a strong contractual base despite a slowdown in new commitments.
kpis.signal: WOW: key indicator of future visibility for SaaS providers.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from subscriptions and professional services.
kpis.description: Sustained growth driven by subscriptions and a strong increase in professional services.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth despite a demanding base.

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from software subscriptions, recognized over time.
kpis.description: Subscriptions represent 84% of total revenue, growing steadily.
kpis.signal: Recurring pillar of the business model.

kpis.name: Professional Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from consulting, training, and accelerated development services.
kpis.description: Professional services more than doubled, driven by priority engineering services.
kpis.signal: Spectacular increase linked to demand for custom services.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of services, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: High gross margin, consistent with a SaaS model with low variable costs.
kpis.signal: High margin typical of cloud software vendors.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Annual loss after all expenses, indicating the path to profitability.
kpis.description: The company continues to invest heavily, with losses slightly increasing.
kpis.signal: Persistent losses despite growth, typical of tech scale-ups.

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue %
kpis.explanation: Proportion of total revenue coming from software subscriptions.
kpis.description: The share of subscriptions in total revenue declined from 90% in 2024 to 84% in 2025, due to strong services growth.
kpis.signal: Decline in subscription share despite absolute growth.

kpis.name: Priority Engineering % of Prof Serv
kpis.explanation: Share of priority engineering services in professional services revenue.
kpis.description: The share of priority engineering services has decreased, signaling increasing maturity of the standard product.

risks.title: Financial Losses
risks.score_rationale: The company has a history of losses and expects to continue recording losses in the future. Losses and accumulated deficit are significant.

risks.title: Growth Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on revenue growth to achieve profitability.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: The market is highly competitive and the company faces established competitors and new entrants.

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company depends heavily on a few key customers and the loss of these customers could negatively impact results.

risks.title: Technology Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must continue to innovate and improve its products to remain competitive.

risks.title: Contract Renewal Risks
risks.score_rationale: Customers have no obligation to renew their contracts and the company must continue delivering high-quality services to maintain customer relationships.

risks.title: Security Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must protect customer data and maintain system security to avoid losses and reputational damage.

ai_positioning.summary: C3.ai is an enterprise AI application software company. The company develops the C3 Agentic AI Platform, industry-specific C3 AI applications, and C3 Generative AI, which combines large language models (LLM), generative AI, reinforcement learning, and natural language processing. These solutions are built on the company's patented architecture and enable organizations to simplify and accelerate the development, deployment, and management of enterprise AI applications.
evidence: C3 AI is the Enterprise AI application software company
C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating Enterprise AI applications
C3 Generative AI library of agentic AI applications to retrieve data, analyze information, surface insights, and orchestrate workflows
Powered by C3 AI's patented agent orchestration technology, C3 Generative AI enables autonomous agents to reflect, collaborate, and execute complex workflows
